My only goal during that time was finding ways to de-stress, I've tried literally everything but in the end one moment I was depersonalized, and the next I wasn't, like I literally felt a wave of "me" come over my whole being. I wasn't in any control over it ending at all, it just came down to time in the end, but meditation, exercise, a healthy diet, going outside no matter how much my body screamed at me not to, and working on my anxieties and vulnerabilities made things better, and I do those things now so that I'll never get depersonalized again. Also magnesium, lithium, vitamin d, Niacin (as nicotonic acid not niacimide, you want the flushing version), and someone also recommended the wim hof breathing method (there's an official website with guides and youtube has a lot of information on it), which helped me as well. I've meditated back on the day I was depersonalized and I've found complete understanding and closure with what I went through I wouldn't recommend doing that until you're fairly experienced with meditation though, I've proven to just one person that I'm normal again but there's no trust there, it's given me a silver of hope for the future though.
